default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_1_2_2 }}
file:
  win19cis_1_2_2_lockoutbadcount:
    title: "1.2.2 | Ensure 'Account lockout threshold' is set to '5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0' | LockoutBadCount"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win19cis_snapshot_dir }}\SystemAccess.LockoutBadCount'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^[1-{{ .Vars.win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count }}]$/'
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win19cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.2.2
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-7
        - AC-19
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/section_1.2.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/section_1.2.x/cis_1.2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role skips this on domain-joined hosts, where domain policy governs it.

odvs.description: win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count is the policy setting that determines the number of failed logon attempts before the account is locked. The recommended state for this setting is: 5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0.
odvs.name: bad_login_lockout_count

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.2.2 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout threshold is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_1_2_2
    - not prelim_win19cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.2.2
    - patch
    - account
    - NIST800-171_3.1.8
    - NIST800-171_3.1.18
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-19
  block:
    - name: "1.2.2 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout threshold is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0 | Set Variable"
      when:
        - win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count <= 5
        - win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count > 0
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: LockoutBadCount
        value: "{{ win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count }}"

    - name: "1.2.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout threshold is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0 | Verify Variable Not 0 or more than 5 warning"
      when:
        - win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count > 5 or
          win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count == 0
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of attempts set for win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "1.2.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout threshold is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempt(s), but not 0 | Set warning count"
      when:
        - win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count > 5 or
          win19cis_bad_login_lockout_count == 0
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.2.2'
